GAP-015.finding: Community includes 26 payment-related modules with 18+ distinct provider webhook implementations all sharing the uniform _process/_apply_updates/_set_done framework; source fully documented; AWT for live webhook delivery and signature verification

GAP-041.finding: Full source chain documented: payment.transaction._post_process (sale override) confirms SO via _check_amount_and_confirm_order and creates invoices via _invoice_sale_orders when sale.automatic_invoice=True; AWT for runtime timing and partial payment edge cases

key_finding: The Community payment webhook chain uses a strict layered override pattern: base _process calls provider-overridden _apply_updates which calls _set_done/_set_pending/etc; account_payment then overrides _post_process to create account.payment and reconcile; sale overrides _post_process to confirm orders and auto-invoice; all 18+ providers follow this exact pattern
